messages.content: Thank you for meeting with me today. To start, I would like to understand the high-level goals for the modernisation of the Legacy Bank mobile app. What are the primary objectives you hope to achieve with this project?

Thanks for having me. Well, to be honest, I just want an app that feels as modern and fast as Revolut. I’m tired of how slow and clunky my current banking app is. I want to know right away when money leaves my account, and it would be great to be able to freeze my card instantly if I misplace it. Basically, I want a smoother experience overall.

Thank you for sharing your thoughts. It sounds like you are looking for improvements in speed, real-time notifications, and enhanced security features. To clarify, when you mention wanting a "smoother experience overall," could you elaborate on what specific aspects of the current app you find slow or clunky? What features or functionalities do you think need the most improvement?

Yeah, so, like I said, the whole thing just feels outdated. It takes ages to load when I want to check my balance or transactions. And I find it super annoying that I don’t get any instant alerts when I spend money. I want to know right away what’s going on with my finances, like how much I have left after a purchase. Also, if I lose my card, I don’t want to have to call someone to freeze it; it should just be a button I can press in the app. That kind of stuff needs to be way better.

I appreciate your detailed feedback. To summarise, you are looking for the following key improvements: 

1. Faster loading times for checking balances and transactions.
2. Real-time alerts for transactions to keep you updated on your spending.
3. A feature that allows you to freeze your card instantly through the app instead of having to call customer support.

These seem to be crucial for enhancing your overall experience with the app. Can you provide more specific examples of what types of real-time alerts you would find most beneficial? For instance, would you like alerts for every transaction, or are there certain thresholds or types of transactions that you would prefer to be notified about?

Yeah, I’d definitely want alerts for every transaction. It’s just nice to know exactly what’s happening, like how much I spent, where I spent it, and what’s left in my account after. I think it would help me keep track of my spending better. I don’t really care about thresholds or anything; just having that instant notification for everything would be great. It’s a bit like what Revolut does, and I find it really helpful.

Thank you for clarifying that. So, to summarise your requirements regarding alerts: 

1. You want instant notifications for every transaction, including details such as the amount spent, the merchant, and the remaining balance in your account. 

This aligns with your goal of better tracking your spending. Now, beyond notifications and card freezing, are there any other specific features or functionalities that you believe would enhance your experience with the app? For example, are you interested in budgeting tools or visual representations of your spending?

Yeah, budgeting tools would be awesome. I’d like to set some monthly budgets for different categories, like groceries or dining out, and then get alerts if I’m getting close to those limits. It would just help me manage my money better. I’m also into the idea of seeing how much I’ve spent in those categories with some kind of breakdown, like a pie chart or something. It’s just easier to understand where my money is going that way.

Thank you for sharing that additional insight. To summarise, you are interested in the following features for the budgeting aspect of the app:

1. The ability to set monthly budgets for different categories, such as groceries and dining out.
2. Alerts when you approach those budget limits.
3. A visual breakdown of your spending by category, potentially using graphs like pie charts for easier understanding.

These features would certainly contribute to a more comprehensive financial management experience. Before we move on, are there any limitations or restrictions we should consider while implementing these budgeting tools, particularly in relation to regulatory compliance or integration with the core banking system?

Honestly, I haven’t really thought about that. I just want the features to work well and be easy to use. I trust you guys to handle the technical stuff and make sure it fits with everything else. My main focus is just having a modern app that helps me manage my money better.

Thank you for your trust in our team to handle the technical aspects. To summarise your focus, you are primarily concerned with ensuring that the app is modern and user-friendly while providing robust features for managing your finances. 

So far, we have identified several clear requirements for the modernisation of the app:

1. Faster loading times for checking balances and transactions.
2. Instant notifications for every transaction, including details of the transaction and the remaining balance.
3. A feature to freeze your card instantly through the app.
4. The ability to set monthly budgets for various categories with alerts for approaching limits.
5. A visual breakdown of spending by category to help track expenses.

Is there anything else you would like to add or any other requirements you believe are important for this project?

I think that covers the main things I really care about. Just making sure the app is fast, easy to use, and has those helpful features would make a huge difference for me. If I think of anything else, I’ll let you know. But for now, I’m good!

Thank you for your input and for helping us identify your key requirements. To confirm, we have established the following five requirements for the modernisation of the Legacy Bank mobile app:

1. Faster loading times for checking balances and transactions.
2. Instant notifications for every transaction, including details of the transaction and the remaining balance.
3. A feature to freeze your card instantly through the app.
4. The ability to set monthly budgets for various categories with alerts for approaching limits.
5. A visual breakdown of spending by category to help track expenses.

These are essential features that will contribute to a modern and user-friendly banking experience. If you think of anything else in the future, please feel free to reach out. 

REQUIREMENTS_COMPLETE
